summary: Measured association between short preceding RR and stroke/filling volume; not universal RR-to-volume calibration.
Beatwise performance depends on cycle length, preload, afterload and contractility.

authored_choices.durationScaling: none; preserve channel baseline ejection and morphology durations

invariants: Coarse and fine AF share events and gain
Gain uses original electrical/mechanical ordinal and immediately preceding electrical RR, never accumulated ejection history
Pressure input, morphology and reference use matching beat strength
No random state, epoch scan, added beats or forced zero-gain beats
Opt-in flags default false and reject unrelated rhythms or simultaneous premature weighting
limitations: Not a physiological stroke-volume or filling model; thresholds/weights are authored
No AF aberrancy, CVP filling, independent right-heart or optical SpO2 calibration
Same ABP/PA gain is a simplified coupled teaching choice, not validated biventricular haemodynamics
